title: 個別マス付きの傘用水受けラック
description: 公共施設や店舗の入口内側に置く十二マスの傘立て。上下二段の開いた格子、独立した細い支柱、脚パッド、低い支持バーと、持ち手・立ち上がり縁のある別体風の浅い水受けトレーを造形。空の個別収納部を持つラックで、植木鉢やごみ箱ではありません。傘・水、排水機能、トレー取り外しや物理動作は付属しません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.604 × 0.616 × 0.396 m、9,664三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A twelve-cell umbrella rack for the inside of public-building and shop entrances. Two open grids separate umbrella shafts above narrow corner posts, contact pads, low support bars and a separate-looking shallow drip tray with raised rims and lifting handles. The storage cells are empty and open, not a planter or litter receptacle. Umbrellas, water, drainage simulation, tray-removal animation and physics behavior are absent. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.604 × 0.616 × 0.396 m; 9,664 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
